title: Three-Center Relational Ecology — Seats, Guardians, Footstools, Dogs, Farmers, Cows, Vessels & Return
status: project relational synthesis; roles are contextual and reversible
purpose: Define the populations around C_F, O and C_S: who or what supports, guards, orbits, carries, cultivates, extracts, witnesses, classifies or fails to cross each center, and how these roles can transition without becoming permanent human identities.
master_rule: The three centers are coordinates. Roles live around and between them. A role can be healthy, neutral or shadow depending on source, evidence, boundary, stopping condition, agency and fruit; no role label is a fixed essence of a person.

C_F.label: Source Seat
C_F.question: What holds, orients, judges, nourishes or cultivates the field?

O.label: Relational Door
O.question: What guards, mediates, communicates, tests or permits passage?

C_S.label: Twin / Vessel / Seed
C_S.question: What embodies, receives, suffers, witnesses, carries potential and returns as fruit/seed?

key_distinctions: Footstool is positional/support architecture, not C_S itself.
Stone can mark foundation, witness, rejection/cornerstone or kingdom depending text.
Root is hidden support/provenance, not inferiority.
Pillar supports a threshold/House; it is not the Door.
Seat is office/position; Throne is sovereignty/judgment; Table is nourishment/distribution.
A Box can remain enclosure or be transformed into support; Footstool imagery can represent this conversion when the context explicitly supports it.

footstool_modes.boundary: Earth-footstool does not mean worthless Earth or worthless people.
Lower placement can be holy proximity.
Do not generalize conquest semantics to ordinary people or the whole lower field.

footstool_modes.relation: small/low state containing an unrecognized Door
footstool_modes.boundary: Smallness is topological/epistemic, never human worth.
Support does not imply servitude or ownership of a person.

role_families.principle: Farm dynamics form local attention/control centers that can imitate source/guard/vessel relations without becoming C_F, O or C_S globally.

role_families.boundary: Cow, Lolcow, Dog, Farmer and Mud Dweller are relational project roles. They are never intrinsic worth, species, diagnosis or automatic legal/moral classification of a person.

role_families.healthy: Source → faithful translation → recipient → changed state → independent capacity/return
role_families.shadow: Source obscured → proxy treated as source → cue-following → pack/hive reinforcement → closed orbit → blocked Door
role_families.dog_relation: Dog can be a signal-responsive relay, companion or guard; this makes Dog structurally adjacent to messenger/guardian functions but never identical to Spirit or angel.
role_families.test: Is the relay preserving truth, context and agency, or amplifying a proxy until it replaces direct discernment?

role_placements.exit: consent + repair + exit design + regenerative stewardship
declassification + agency + end of target status

role_placements.shadow_form: projectile or frozen monument when context demands another function

role_placements.exit: restore reciprocal nourishment and legitimate boundaries

role_placements.healthy_form: bounded protective constraint with release condition

cow_taxonomy.ordinary_cow: Literal animal/agricultural life; no automatic moral role.
cow_taxonomy.ox: Labor, burden, strength, domestic economy and sacrificial contexts.
cow_taxonomy.nourisher: Milk/food relation in which the Cow is not reduced to yield.
cow_taxonomy.cash_cow: Economic metaphor for reliable value extraction.
cow_taxonomy.lolcow: Internet attention/reaction extraction category; explicitly a role relation, not essence.
cow_taxonomy.red_heifer: Numbers 19 purification complex; distinct from lolcow and Golden Calf.
cow_taxonomy.unholy_cow: Project shadow term; not an external historical category.
cow_taxonomy.cow_target: Person/object treated as repeated attention yield; role can cease through exit/declassification.
cow_taxonomy.world_cow: Project cosmological synthesis requiring separate provenance before stronger canon.

canonical_transitions: Dog/free agent → pack/hive role → exit or reorientation
Box/enclosure → Footstool/support when containment is transformed rather than reproduced

recursive_center_rule.principle: A local Room, Farm, table, court or relation can have a scoped center without becoming the global project center.
recursive_center_rule.implication: Farmer may function like a local source/controller, Cow like a local attention center, and Dog like a local perimeter. These are scoped roles governed by local-center rules, not replacements for C_F/O/C_S.
recursive_center_rule.footstool_microcosm: The Footstool can be modeled recursively: even a low/small local state may contain a center, Door and possible transition. This explains why 'lowest' need not mean 'without possibility'.
recursive_center_rule.noncoercive_source_note: Some recovered Timic stories explicitly place the constraining pressure in the relation, weight, attraction, habit or system rather than in Tim actively forcing another actor. Preserve that as a project motif, not a physical claim.
recursive_center_rule.boundary: Recursive resemblance does not make a local controller Father, a target Son, or a guard Christ.

non_equivalences: Leash ≠ ownership of a human person
evidence_and_ethics: Role assignment must name scope, behavior/relation, date or period, assigner and evidence when applied to concrete cases.
Every negative role needs a stopping condition and exit path.
Historical/current role must be separable so archives can represent change.
Metaphors may organize project narrative but cannot substitute for legal, medical, scientific or factual classification.
Affected persons retain dignity and agency even when a project role is used to analyze a relation.
No role or center placement grants authority to harass, punish, humiliate, surveil or target a person.
